form.subject: Subject
form.privacy: To protect your patients, don’t include names, ID numbers or clinical information: describe the situation in general terms. The Salutti team reads your request and automatically sees the page you were on, your browser and screen size, only to understand the problem.

bug.label: Something isn’t working
bug.help: Tell us what you tried to do, what happened and what you expected. E.g.: “When saving the session in the Schedule, the screen froze.”

acesso.label: Sign-in and access
acesso.help: Tell us what happens when you sign in (password, 2FA code, team invite). Never send your password.

duvida.label: How-to question
duvida.help: Tell us which screen you’re on and what you want to do.

financeiro.label: Plan and billing
financeiro.help: Salutti subscription, billing or plan change.

privacidade.label: Privacy and data protection
privacidade.help: Data subject request, data export or deletion, consent form.

sugestao.label: Suggestion
sugestao.help: What improvement would help your routine? Tell us the problem it solves.

outro.label: Something else
outro.help: Write in your own words, we’ll route it.

sent.title: We received request #{number}
sent.body: We’ll reply here. When there’s a reply, the support button shows a dot.

errors.invalid: Choose a topic, write a subject (3+ letters) and describe what happened.
errors.limit: Too many messages in a short time. Try again in an hour.

mine.empty: You haven’t opened any requests yet.

access.banner: Support access to the {workspace} account: read-only, no clinical content. Ends at {time}.
access.noticeTitle: The Salutti team accessed your account
access.noticeHelp: During the access, the Salutti team could see patients’ schedule, records and billing, without changing or sending anything. Clinical records, progress notes, intake forms, clinical photos, consent forms and free-text notes are not visible. Each access lasts at most 15 minutes and is kept in the audit log.
